source_handling: Six phases, dates, gate windows and scenario estimates retained, unrelated gift-processing story adapted to stewardship reporting; all quantities illustrative.

program.name: University Stewardship Reporting Program · Six-Phase Operating Plan
program.problem: Decentralized donor impact reports lack one controlled intake, evidence standard, approval path and production calendar. Reconciliation and claim validation can be duplicated or missed across schools and units.
program.outcome: Create a coordinated reporting operation: gift-type report standards, certified source-to-claim evidence, a Six-Check Release Gate, timely mass delivery, and documented follow-up.

in: Discover: Reporting inventory, service tiers, donor intent and source-data requirements
Design: Gift-type templates, source standards, VERITAS editorial structure and Release Gate
Build: Reporting intake, financial tie-outs, evidence packets, tracking and batch preflight
Pilot: Endowed and current-use report samples, program and Finance review
Scale: Capital and restricted-grant reporting; annual delivery calendar; staff training
Evaluate: Monthly scorecards, report retirement audit, acceptance and benefits review
out: Changes to systems of record without the data owner’s approval
Policy changes owned by other offices
awaiting: Sponsor and owners approve scope at Gate 0 (proposed)
Access to institution-approved donor, fund and accounting sources (not included in this demonstration)
Academic, Gift Administration, Finance and privacy decisions before production
Illustrative 1.5 FTE planning capacity; replace with validated staffing assessment
scope.provenance: PROPOSED — TRANSFORMED FROM ATTACHED DRAFT; NOT AN APPROVED INSTITUTIONAL PROGRAM

release_gate: Intent / Reconciliation / Consent / Traceability / Attribution / Authorization
editorial: VERITAS: Vision / Experience / Results / Investment / Truth / Advancement / Stewardship
